concerns.text: Task T008 [FR‑011] (preprocess_and_ground_truth) is listed as a consumer of raw PR data, but the producer task T007 (fetch_prs) is not placed before it in the declared execution order. The plan’s ‘Execution order’ section states Phase 2 – T006 → T008, omitting T007, creating a consumer‑before‑producer violation.
